## What is a Wind Walker WW?
**W**ind **W**alker (WW) is the Master class of Beast Master (BM)
Beginner -> Archer -> Hunter -> Beast Master -> Wind Walker

Similar to DB, you will have a "Tempest form" (in DB it was the "Wraith Form", which is a toggle-able talent where you gain nearly no external account bonuses except from the compass.
Main Difference:
- The WW, unlike the DB, now has items such as rings, bows and enchant stones!
- Mobs have weaknesses such as fire, grass etc, and certain items gain an advantage if you use the proper elemental damage.

Main Benefits of a WW:
- It has insane mob respawn now, unlike BM, leveling your pet shinies will be a lot quicker.
- It has great buffs to Sneaking.
- It has stamp doublers, yes it is what it sounds like, double the perk of a stamp.
- Gives a lot of Class XP, this will be important in W7 - Lava stream
- ⚠️ What else to add?

*Masterius NPC*

- The quest is to "listen to your inner voice" and find the Deer.

## Quest **QUEST: How to unlock WW?** 
DO NOT TRIGGER YOUR SUMMONING! 
*(Unless you want to, but you don't yet, as there's a way to get a bunch of extra summoning XP from the new stamp doublers)*

*TP = Teleport*
- Go W6 Zone 4, Baby Trolls and speak to Masterius NPC
- You can TP to W6 Town (or W5 and walk to the W6 portal)
- Walk down the worlds through the main portal in each town,
- The correct world will say "The reindeer is somewhere around here...."
- Go through the world (NO TELEPORT) zone to zone.
- Find the reindeer "Look, over there! Quickly, strike them down before they flee!"
- Kill the reindeer.
- Teleport back to W6 Baby Trolls.
Warning: If you ever TP, you have to go back to W6 Zone 4 (or World 6 town? ⚠️ )

BUG: There's apparently been a few cases where to location of the Deer is not accessible. You may leave the portal, and reenter which should change the deer location in that specific zone.

## How to get Talent points for Wind Walker
*The current assumption is that it's the same as DB, I did NOT double check this yet!* ⚠️ 

- Alchemy does NOT give Talent points to Tab 5!

**Talents Points: **
- 3 Talent Points every Class level above 250 (including 250)
- 50 Flurbos from Dungeon
- 100 W6 Merit Shop (+5 per level)
- 1 Talent point per every 5th Level per individual skill from W1-W3 skills
```(level - 249) * 3 + flurbo + 5 * merit + Sum(floor(skillLevel / 5), for each w1-w3 skill)``` by <@146038451790282753> I believe <:Hearto:812252292597547018> 

For the Skill levels, this means if woodcutting is level 9, you get 1 point (because level 5) If you have woodcutting and mining level 9 each thats only 2 points, you do NOT add the skills up together, its per individual skill.

## **Leveling your Wind Walker**  ⚠️ 
If you want to level Wind Walker for more Talent Points, the main things that matter are:
- Justice Monument Class XP (as it is a lot more obtainable than GT)
- More Cavern Class XP (The 3 Monuments)
- GT, Alchemy Grind Time Bubble for +% Class XP)
- Play WW until you get Stamp doublers to double Crystallin! (Crystal chance stamp)
- Chocolate chip (For crystals, they give 30x The XP)

- Active XP is way better than Offline.
- Multi XP items such as "4th Year Nametag" or "True Crown" premium hat from a bundle, "Evergreen Robe" from WW Bundle.
- Various small things that you should know, aka star signs active XP, card sets, card, gold food, chips etc.

## Before you  start 
Clean up your Character!

- Remove Prayers like +% HP
- Setup Food
- Focus on Drop rate setup for now (more to this later)
- Level your Cavern Lamp for Breeding bonuses, since you're pushing this may as well push Shinies or Breedability.
- Star Signs: Breedability in Red + Drop Rate
- Random stuff like PO for CDR
- Get all Max books at library.
- Filter a bunch of random drops
- Go to regular Dungeon and unlock the drops before you forget forever.
- Clean Up your inventory, you'll want 1-2 bag tabs just for WW related items, then for all the drops you get while moving around. More to it in Setup later.
- ⚠️ Unsure if DB "Skull of Major Talents" works on DB/WW, either way if you dont have it now, it's too far away anyways.

-  Back to Breeding, you can prep with 1 of each breedability pet since WW Talent 8 (Crit chance) scales based on total breedability Levels and then level 27 at a time.

## What are Abominations? 
- Abominations can be found when in Tempest form on various maps.
- They have high HP, but once killed they unlock a node in your compass
- Each Abomination gives a bonus from that node.
- If you change map and havnt killed it, their HP refills to 100%
- ~~They apparently do more dmg the lower their hp is (or as time goes on, pretty sure its based on their hp)~~ Apparently no longer a thing as of 4/29 update.
- Certain content scales with total Abominations Slain (E.g. WW Talent 15)
- If struggling due to lag from a lot of items, remove Uwu and Deer, you will sacrifice a lot of dust though

## Medallions
- Medallions are unlocked in the Elemental Path *(see image below)*
- They have a very low drop rate, this can be increased through other Compass nodes.
- Higher worlds have lower drop rates for them
- They will spawn on the ground and you have to manually pick it up!
- Always check the full map before moving zones
- Any zone change/reload like gemshop will remove the loot including Medallions from the floor.
- Every single regular mob drops it's own Medallion. 
- You can see if you have the Mobs Medallion on the Card UI, top left corner *(see image below)* or use scoli's beta autoreview
- Must be in tempest form (as the node says) to get them as a drop.
- Use Prayer "Glitterbug", only way to spawn crystals in Tempest. Use Choco as well.
- **Anything that is killable in tempest can drop a medallion, this includes minis like baba yaga, glunko, every type of colo chest in each colo, bug nests, event mobs that spawn from vday letters, oysters. etc.**
- **Be sure to read the very helpful tips!**  https://discord.com/channels/437797104786604034/1364336466679042138/1364336598598287421


What it does
- If you have a specific mobs medallion, it gives massively more Class XP, this will be good for higher world later.
- "Medallion Magnate" in Elemental Path gives +1% Tempest Damage per and Accuracy/level PER Medallion found.

## Medallions TIPS and Locations:
- All Mobs that can be killed drop medallions, the medallions are mob based and NOT zone based like chow/zow. So a Nutto is just 1 nutto, the TD Nutto would NOT drop another since it's the same mob itself.
- Colo chests (Wood, Silver, Gold)  each drop one, for each specific world too! (18 Medallions)
- Colo specific mobs like Dig Doug, Xylobone,.... 
- Minis like Baba yaga, Glunko, Biggies,... (anything thats killable)

## **Tips + Strategy for hard Medallions** (suggested by <@372840582021775365> )
- Remember to level your medallion (and all item) drop chance in the compass first. (Elemental Path)
- Elemental Path 15 "Top of the Morning" aka TotM: The first 10/level kills at the start of each day have a 200x chance to drop Tempest Items
- This means you can prepare a colo few minutes before your daily reset, kill the mob preferably manually (no long term abilities like traps) then you just see your colo chests, wait for reset, then destroy the desired chests.
- Same thing can be applied to things like boops, minibosses, random event bosses, or event mobs that are hard to get. Follow the next list.
- For Crystal Medallions you can unequip your Giant Prayer until daily resets for Top of the Morning buff and do it with Glitterbug to not let your giant kills go up. Then equip the Giant Prayer on reset with the Glitterbug on reset when you have TotM. You can also unequip your bow if your giant rate is frequent and try to focus just the giant/crystal on the reset with TotM. Once your TotM runs out, unequip your Giant spawning prayer again. - <@381360374395568138> 

**Strategy LIST:**
- Have "Top of the Mornin" unlocked in Elemental Path (See image beneath)
- Wait until ~5min until reset
- Enter colo, destroy it all EXCEPT Chests
- Wait for reset to happen (should see NBLB, NSLB, NMLB pop ups)
- Destroy the Chests, remember if any didnt drop to know if you need to go back
- Dr Defaceus
- Boops
- Minis like Glunko, baba yaga, king doot, biggie hour, Slush,  pmush, 
- Use Event Items Lovey Dovey Letter, Beach Oyster, Gummy Bunny for Valentslime, Floofie, Shell snake, Plasti Dough, Mr blueberry
- Could check if Random Event Boss is up

## Talent Point Priority
In my opinion, since Accuracy, Def and even Damage (except for Abominations) are not a bottleneck, we focus on respawn mechanics and talents that help us clear the map quick + Dust. Then we go for stats like Acc/Def/Dmg stuff.


Max the Talents in order:
Talent 5 = Some Commandments
Talent 3 = Spirit Ballista
Talent 4 = Eternal Hunt
Talent 2 = Compass

Talent 7 = Elemental Mayhem
~~Talent 6 = Windborne~~
Talent 8 = Pumpin' Power
Talent 1 = Tempest Form.
Talent 6 = Windborne (moved down as Acc + def have not been an issue.
*Can also add 1 point into each talent first*

Optional:
- Can consider flipping 5 and 6 depending on what you need, dmg for abominations or acc/def. Could even throw in 8 first.
- 4 vs 3 could be flipped in situational approaches, but at this point it's safe to assume you're able to max at least 1-4 anyways.
- Can go out of Tempest to reset a specific talent and move it to more Damage for abominations, e.g. Talent 2 (dust) to Talent 1 (Damage)

## How to progress (to next world)
- Unlocking the next world requires a certain amount of Abominations slaid to be unlocked
- You require Dust to unlock the portals.
- To unlock a portal, if you have enough dust, hold down on it for ~2 seconds, then let go.
- The "Map" will not show the next world as unlocked unless you go through the portal in the town first!

W1 Portals Require Dust 1
W2 Portals Require Dust 1
W3 Portals Require Dust 2
W4 Portals Require Dust 2 
W5 Portals Require Dust 3 
W6 Portals Require ⚠️

Portals will cap at 2b dust somewhere in w5. So it doesn't get as bad to unlock/push, besides dmg.
Unlocking all of W5 was around 12-13b i believe

**W1 - 3 **
- W1 and w2 Elemental is not that important, but using the correct one for an abom might help a tiny bit.
- Kill the bare minimum of abominations to get to the next world, grind dust in the next world at way higher rates then backtrack in a bit. (Check if the Abom you skipped has an actually helpful bonus)
- Should not have any issues with Def, Acc or Dmg, you should be 1 shotting everything (except Aboms).
**W3: **
- For W3 abominations you may consider it a lot more (1-2x Grass Rings, or crit dmg, there's sadly currently no bow). Get a decent WP bow. preferably a 2/5 (with 10% stones), Getting 1/3 or 2/3 on the rings can help a lot too.
- To get to W4 you need to get all abominations up to quenchies (no Neyeptune or Bloodbone)
- Be sure to get a 

**W4:**    *(Dust costs are unsure after a serversided adjustment where they keep increasing, from e.g. 4.2b to 5.2b now 6.5b+)*
- This is the first "hard part" specifically the abominations, ignore them for now.
- Your main goal will be to unlock "Stone Failsafe" in Elemental Path level 17, 6.5b+ dust 1 and costs ~200m Dust 3 to max to 50%
- Stone Failsafe = 50% chance to NOT use up an upgrade slow when you fail!
- Make sure you have two  2/3 or better +%Dust rings, and have at least a 2/5  +%Dust bow, but def. better a 3/5.
- Then after having failsafe you start going for a Better Bow (wind to kill aboms) and hope for a 3/5 upgrade (or 4/5), you want 1 or 2  2/3 to 3/3 Dmg rings. Getting a 3/3 ring shouldnt be too hard, the main reason is for the WP, having a high base stat would be nice, you could toss anything thats lower than ⚠️ WP for the 3/3 dmg rings (good time to just get these for long term), but else just try and get the 2/3s asap. 
- See the probability of getting x/5 bows before and after ele 17 here: https://discord.com/channels/437797104786604034/1364336466679042138/1364336711303303189

**W5:**
- Ignore Aboms for now.
- Just grind dust, backtrack medallions, go for more dust %, dmg to 1 shot mobs, etc.
- Only pick up bows that are 50-55+ WP, or if you want even 60+ WP (bit less if good speed), drop the rest, and get a 3/5 at minimum, preferably a 4/5 for fire and ice for the later Aboms. 
- Think it was around 200-300m+ dmg for less than a day for the last Abom? (Elemental bow + 2x Dmg rings)
- Pushing to W6 will surely help but gets rough and you won't benefit "too much" from it besides dust

W6:
- You will get more dust in these early w6 maps with a dust bow + 1 dust ring + 1 element ring setup.

- Items have a lot of RNG, the Rings have a range on their stat, the bows have a range difference on their speed, weapon power and the stat. You could get a hypersonic speed bow or a <:slowpokeW:809218410436755527>  (slow) bow, it can have a ton of Weapon power or barely any.
